verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a SaaS platform with an API-and-MCP docs section, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents only MCP server connection and service keys, not an interactive API reference with runnable examples. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
